target: CT MXFP4 experts with the already-tested native MXFP8 KDA conversion
baseline: The unchanged FP8 DFlash2 drafter, source SHA256 6cba1cff8ab4fcd657b89575f5db3debe1f5a39c78bda422953f553dc2357f8b

comparison.timing: Unprofiled request submission through final received token, including TTFT
comparison.cache_policy: Same warmed model and cold per-request prefix state in both arms
comparison.aggregation: Median trials per prompt per arm; geometric mean of paired candidate/baseline ratios within each domain
comparison.uncertainty: 10000 paired prompt bootstrap resamples, seed 42; preserve all trials and load medians
comparison.repeat_gate_formula: (max - min) / median of three per-load domain throughput medians
comparison.draft_rounds: Count only target-verification rounds contributing to the fixed 256-token response; report post-cap work separately

sealed_test.opening_policy: Freeze one candidate selected on validation; then open test once. A failed test remains failed; new tuning requires a fresh test.

legacy_code_diagnostic.status: Already observed; never a sealed test or training prompt
legacy_code_diagnostic.scope: Secondary regression anchor only; its absolute rounds target does not apply to unrelated code prompts.

required_later: actual long-context quality and latency qualification
qualification.draft_length_and_mtp_baselines: Separate development experiments; do not tune on the sealed test or change this seven-draft comparison silently.
qualification.natural_stop_workloads: Report separately; fixed 256-token timing is a controlled proxy, not a guarantee for arbitrary user requests.
qualification.failure_policy: Retain failures. No pass from noisy controls, incomplete domains, or a confidence interval that fails its threshold.
